annotations.text:
Landscape system, v4: showpiece energy

Each screen opens with one choreographed reveal: the sun rises onto the ridge, the clarity sun travels its arc, the Path draws itself, the seal ring fills, photographs drift (Ken Burns), stars twinkle. Rays turn slowly; mist drifts. Reduced-motion turns it all off.

Bigger statements (40–112px), punchier dawn and dusk skies, a gold sun button with a slow shimmer. Use the Sky tweak on Today for the four phases.

Motion map for the build (Reanimated + Skia):
· Sunrise on open: 2.4s spring, glow pulse after.
· Check-in: sun-arc pops, horizon glow increments, one warm sound + light haptic.
· Interview: sun moves along the arc as clarity rises.
· Blueprint / Goal: Path strokes draw in, nodes pop in sequence.
· Seal: ring fills over 3.2s while held, haptic ramp, ink-fill on release.
· Scenes: 30s Ken Burns, narrative fades in at 0.9s.
Photographs stand in for generated scenes (Unsplash licence: Tyler Criso, Kevin Bessat). In the product each scene is generated from the user's own words, graded to this palette and grained.
